candidates.title: Hide prices for unavailable Dawn variants

demandEvidence.chore: Displaying variant-specific unit prices in the Dawn storefront.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: How to hide price for out-of-stock variants on Dawn theme v15

ease.reason: A learner can prototype the display rule with fictional variants, but no attached source documents Dawn theme implementation.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: Shopify service providers or merchants may pay for storefront customization; this request establishes no payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can test a supplied variant and visibility rule; live theme behavior and the intended rule need human verification.

autonomy.reason: A mock can recalculate visibility from selected variant data, while a person must define pricing rules and approve storefront changes.

evidence.reason: The discussion text gives an out-of-stock variant price example, but the body is title-writing advice and does not establish recurrence or implementation.

candidates.reason: Experiment assessed: enter fictional variant availability and a proposed display rule, recalculate whether a price appears, compare with hand-checked examples, and require a person to verify any live change. Below threshold (24/5 = 4.8). Also rejected as a duplicate customer dimension: Shopify merchants overlap the online retailers in recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6.

rejected.title: How to display unit prices dynamically based on variant selection in Dawn theme?
rejected.reason: Scored assessment is in candidates and below threshold (4.8). Its only concrete phrase is an out-of-stock variant price example inside generic title-writing advice; a fictional variant display test is possible, but no recurrence or theme implementation is evidenced. Shopify merchants also overlap the online-retailer customer in recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6.

rejected.title: URGENT – Locked out of Shopify account – Business operations blocked
rejected.reason: The post describes a one-off account lockout preventing order management and access to information, but names no recurring bounded task an AI service could perform. Account recovery requires human platform access; proposing order handling would invent duties beyond the evidence.

steps.message: Assessed the omitted variant-price request with all five criteria and a bounded fictional-data experiment; it scores below threshold and overlaps the recent online-retailer customer. Retained the separate one-off account-lockout exclusion. No post proposed.
